title: Hu Taong
tagline: Pong, the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor way.
description: A Hu Tao themed take on Pong. Play a friend on one keyboard or online, or take on the AI at five difficulties from Baby to Insane in four styles. Mix seven game modes, from Chaos and Switch to Black Hole, grab talismans that change the court, and pick from three physics. Replays and highlights, over thirty backgrounds, mood-matched music, match stats, and touch controls on Android.

versions.notes:
Three physics to choose from, a Speed Cap so a charge shot can always be reached, the Black Hole talisman and game mode, and a review of the talismans.
- Physics: Current, Classic or v0.9, and a Speed Cap, under Ball & Paddles
- Black Hole: pulls the ball in, grows with each ball it swallows, then collapses into Twin Balls and mini black holes; also a game mode, in place of Portal Pair
- Portal Pair: ovals with a dotted way out, half a second inside
- Talismans reviewed: Talismans at Once, effects that last through points, Tombstones that wear down, fade-outs
- A ball squeezed between two paddles rattles between them again
- Online needs both players on 1.8

builds.note: Touch controls. Plays online with Hu Taong 1.8 on a PC.

versions.notes:
Game modes you can mix on Match Setup, a reworked Switch, match settings from the pause menu, tidier settings menus, and drifting portals.
- Seven game modes, any of them together: Chaos, Switch, Curveball, Lantern Night, Twin Ball, Talisman Rush and Portal Pair
- Switch: you take over the other paddle and keep your keys and your score; mid-rally switches go off at a hit
- Change the rules mid-match from Pause > Settings > Match, from the next serve
- Settings regrouped into Match, Gameplay, Display, Audio and UI
- Portal Pair's portals drift, turn and grow
- Online needs both players on 1.7

builds.note: Touch controls. Plays online with Hu Taong 1.7 on a PC.

versions.notes:
Every power-up reviewed, then two rounds of changes from playtesting.
- Fixes for Snowball, Portal Pair, Sticky Goo, Safety Teleport and the Middle Wall
- Gravity and Frostbite removed; Chaos Mode + is now Shape Shift
- The Firecracker bangs on a 5-second fuse, counted down over the ball
- A 3-2-1 before play resumes, Mute buttons, a Court Dim slider and Reset Ball & Paddles
- Far fewer stutters mid-match
- Online needs both players on 1.6. Reinstall 1.6 to get this update

builds.note: Touch controls. Plays online with Hu Taong 1.6 on a PC.

versions.notes:
Smoother online play, and hits that look the same on both screens.
- The ball no longer freezes, slips back or passes through a paddle online
- Saves no longer turn into goals when the connection stalls
- Plays on Android too, with touch controls
- Online needs both players on 1.5

builds.note: Touch controls. Plays online with Hu Taong 1.5 on a PC.

versions.notes:
Fixes for hits off a paddle's ends, and for a friend leaving an online match.
- Balls off a paddle's end no longer shoot off far too fast
- When a friend leaves online, you get the end-of-match screen

Online play, replays, courts and twelve new power-ups.
- Play a friend online with a code, or in a public room
- Instant replays, saved matches, clips and highlights
- Five courts, twelve new power-ups and harder hits
- Stats you can export, including online wins

Power-ups arrive, with more backgrounds and music and a full jukebox.
- Eleven power-ups: Boons, Curses and Wild
- Game Pace, ambience and smoother fades between tracks
- 34 backgrounds and 58 music tracks in all

AI styles, key rebinding, new Chaos modes and an Interface settings page.
- Four AI styles, and an AI that banters
- Hand a paddle to the AI mid-match, or take the Middle Wall down
- Chaos Mode + and Chaos Switch

First release, with a new Wangsheng Funeral Parlor look.
- New panels, fonts, effects and score banners
- 29 backgrounds and 43 music tracks

Match setup, stats, and settings that are remembered.
- Choose your opponent and paddle, against an adaptive AI
- Chaos Mode, a Stats screen and music that fits the mood
A behind-the-scenes rebuild of the menus and sound.
Endless Mode and a bigger soundtrack.
Faster rallies and a fairer AI.
A rewrite with proper physics and sound.
